_why_this_file_exists: EVS-3. Chapter 1's content carries a role_variant for all sixteen Bimaristan Resilience Council roles, because canon's role table has sixteen rows. Sixteen selectable roles is not sixteen roles brought to slice depth — it is one role's worth of authoring repeated sixteen times, and a selector offering all of them promises a variation the slice does not have. This file names the two the experience vertical slice actually carries.
_what_is_NOT_here: The other fourteen. They are COMPUTED from the scenes' own role_variants — see src/engine/roles.js. A hand-written list of what is excluded goes stale the moment a role is added to the content, and it goes stale silently, which is the failure this project keeps paying for.

evs_selectable.chosen_because: Canon's own first row, and the only role whose direct contribution is coordination across every other role's boundary. It is the role that sees the outage, the fallback, the capacity shortage and the network option as one problem with no owner.

The strongest contrast available in canon: it holds no clinical, electrical or executive authority and its whole contribution is what survives closure. Where the resilience lead coordinates the event, this role argues about how the event is recorded — so the two disagree about what the chapter was, which is what makes role choice testable rather than asserted.

unresolved.why: Canon's role table has ONE evidence column ('First evidence noticed'). The content wrote it into two fields, and starting_position === information_held in all 64 variants. One of the two was never authored; which one canon intends is a content decision, not an engineering one.

A role's position, evidence and contribution are identical in all four scenes, because canon assigns them PER ROLE and not per scene. So the role changes what a player is told about themselves, and does not yet change what they learn as the chapter proceeds.

Canon says the guaranteed clue is understood differently by role — 'whether the player first understands it as electrical, logistical, historical, or informational evidence'. The content gives all sixteen roles the same route sentence, so that framing is declared in canon and absent from the content. EVS-4 is where role-filtered evidence is built.
